subject: No response: Discovery call recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@polaris-tech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 03 Jan 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery call recap & suggested next steps

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for taking time earlier today to walk through Polaris Tech's search/FAQ use case. Quick recap and a proposed next step so we can keep momentum: 

Recap:
- Primary goal: reduce time-to-answer for support agents and embed knowledge in product help center.
- Key constraints: on-prem data for sensitive manuals, 95th%-ile latency target < 150ms for the UI, and moderate qps (~50 peak).
- Success metric: 30% reduction in average handle time + improved CSAT on knowledge articles.

Proposed next step:
1) Technical skim + pilot: Redwood Dedicated pilot (4 GPUs) + on-prem connector - 4 week pilot to validate latency and retrieval quality.
2) Mutual action plan: Rishi can scope infra and data connectors; I can put together a pilot statement of work and high-level cost.

I attached my discovery notes and a short pilot outline (see attachment). If that sounds reasonable, can you confirm: (a) priority for H1? (b) who needs to be on the pilot review (PM/Infra/Legal)?

If easier, I'm happy to set a 20-min follow-up to align stakeholders.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: discovery-notes-20270103.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa

Subject: Quick check-in — fit & next step (Feb?)

Hi Claire —

Thanks for the update earlier — totally understand the roadmap crunch. I'm checking in now to: (a) see whether February looks better for a 20-min sync and (b) get quick feedback on fit so we can prioritize internal resources. A couple quick options:

- Option A: Schedule a 20-min sync in early Feb for a brief technical skim + mutual action plan.
- Option B: If now isn't the right time, I can close the loop and reach back in April unless you tell me otherwise.

Two quick clarifying Qs that would help Rishi scope the connector if you plan to restart:
1) Is on-prem deployment a hard requirement for the pilot or would a dedicated VPC be acceptable for the initial PoC?
2) Who on infra should Rishi loop in to discuss networking/whitelisting?

If it helps, I'm happy to put a short calendar invite for early Feb and we can cancel if schedules don't align. Let me know what you prefer.

Cheers,
Marissa
